title: Metal-free access to 4-indolyl coumarin from coumarin 3-carboxylic acid and indole via a Michael addition-decarboxylation and dehydrogenation protocol: a photo-physical study and utility as an invisible ink
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37888-37898
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05851A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sourav Chakraborty, Arghyadeep Bhattachrjyya, Bhaswati Paul, Barnali Das, Ramalingam Natarajan, Swapan Majumdar
Here, two-step synthesis of coumarin-indole hybrids from coumarin 3-carboxylic acid and indole is reported. The photo-physical properties of the synthesized hybrids and their possible use as invisible ink are also investigated.
